limitations: the two-deformable-sphere problem is solved in its exact Hertz equivalent form (rigid indenter on a half-space); the reduction is a closed-form theorem, not a numerical approximation, but the run does not exercise a two-body contact algorithm
the contact is frictionless, adhesion-free, small-strain and small-slope; p_0 = 3.45 GPa is far above the yield strength of ordinary steel, so this is a verification of the elastic operator only
penalty contact adds a compliance bias of O(overlap/delta) which shows up in the contact force; the penalty study quantifies it instead of hiding it
the recovered (a, p_0) rest on a least-squares fit of p^2 vs r^2 over the active set, so they inherit the discrete pressure noise (see observed order)
